description:
Mark Check (cv-mark-check-v1, free): Says whether an image carries the marks CraterView.ai puts on every image its models make or change, and if it does, which model made or changed it and when. `job.result.verdict` (`made`, `changed`, `not_found`): `made`: a new image a CraterView.ai model made. `changed`: an image a CraterView.ai model changed. `not_found`: no CraterView.ai mark was found, which does not show the image never passed through CraterView.ai: a screenshot drops the credential, and heavy editing can remove the watermark. `job.result.mark`: The mark's identifier, as the image's watermark and its Content Credential carry it. `GET /v1/marks/{mark}` answers which model made or changed the image, and when. Present when a mark was found. `job.result.model`: The model that made or changed the image, by its catalogue name. Present when the image carries CraterView.ai's Content Credential. `job.result.made_at`: When the image was made or changed. Present when the image carries CraterView.ai's Content Credential. `job.result.found_in`: Where the mark was read: the image's signed Content Credential, its invisible watermark, or both. A mark found only in the watermark names an image CraterView.ai made or changed, but a watermark can be copied into another image: only the credential shows that this file is that image. Present when a mark was found. `job.result.as_signed`: Whether the file is exactly the one CraterView.ai signed: false means it has been edited or saved again since. Null when the image carries no CraterView.ai credential. Present when a mark was found.

This check changes nothing and costs nothing, so it needs no go-ahead: call it when its answer would help, and say what it found.

Send the image as `input_key`: upload_photo answers with one.

An answer's `job` is the job as the API states it. On a finished job, `usage` is the account as get_usage answers it.

Most images finish inside this call, with the answer in `job.result`. A slower one answers with `job.status` queued or running: collect it with get_job and `job.id`. Calling this tool again would run the work again.

input_key.description: The image: the `input_key` upload_photo answered with, or a File ID the user copied from their CraterView.ai workspace.

name: check_mark
